CRM Theme Gallery

13 options from Gemini research GEM-CRM-003 (facts unverified). Screenshots taken 2026-10-09 at 1440×900. Broken links from the Gemini report were replaced by the Lead; Horizon UI (demo offline) and the Twenty sign-in wall were removed; Haze shows the seller page (its live demo opens from there). Click a link to open the live demo.
